tasks.goal: Guide human stewards along the Charter Hall exhibit path, presenting charter panels while maintaining stable bipedal balance.
tasks.terrain: Flat polished concrete exhibition floor simulating a port-terminal office; cable ramps and panel plinths as obstacles.
success: Visits all 5 charter panels in order
Stops within 0.3 m of each panel
safety_stops: E-stop if human within 0.8 m in path
Abort gait on tilt >10 deg
Stop if battery <20%
tasks.human_in_loop: Human steward confirms tour route start and receives charter summaries before any reading aloud.

tasks.goal: Build and continuously update a 2D occupancy map of the Research Synthesis Lab, syncing coverage of evidence stations to the map server.
tasks.terrain: Wide lab floor with server racks, desk clusters, and palletized server crates mimicking Maasvlakte 2 container-office blocks.
safety_stops: Stop on bump switch trigger
Slow to 0.3 m/s near humans
Halt if localization covariance exceeds threshold
tasks.human_in_loop: Human researcher approves the map before it is published to the Progress Observatory.

tasks.goal: Pick printed proposal drafts from the tray and place them into the human voting booth slots, never initiating any enactment action.
tasks.terrain: Stationary booth table; paper stacks, slot guides, and a guard fence typical of port-terminal control desks.
safety_stops: Stop if human hand enters workspace via light curtain
Pause on force/torque threshold exceedance
Halt if slot sensor reports blockage
tasks.human_in_loop: A person performs all final votes and enactment; robot only moves paper drafts to the booth.

tasks.goal: Arrange task-routing tokens on the operations board to mirror the Task Router agent's current working-group assignments.
tasks.terrain: Vertical token board beside the deck console; token bins, monitor edges, and desk lip as collision hazards.
success: Board state matches router output within 5 s
safety_stops: Reflex stop on contact force >10 N
Stop if human within 0.5 m of board
Pause on joint velocity limit
tasks.human_in_loop: Human coordinator approves each working-group assignment before tokens are moved on the board.

tasks.goal: Quadruped inspection walk along the Progress Observatory gantry-catwalk sim, recording outcome-metric displays for progress tracking.
tasks.terrain: Steel grating catwalk modeled on Maasvlakte 2 gantry crane walkways; slippery grating, railings, height exposure, sea wind vibration.
safety_stops: Sit-and-stop if slip detected twice within 10 s
Abort if pitch >20 deg
Return-to-dock if battery <25%
Halt if catwalk vibration exceeds threshold
tasks.human_in_loop: Human steward reviews captured display photos before metrics enter the progress record.

tasks.goal: Low-altitude perimeter patrol around the lab ceiling line, checking overhead cable trays and lighting for the evidence-monitoring station.
tasks.terrain: Indoor airspace with cable trays, ductwork, and suspended LED fixtures echoing port warehouse infrastructure; strong AC drafts.
success: Position hold error <0.15 m in drafts
safety_stops: Auto-land if range sensor shows obstacle <0.3 m
Land if battery <25%
Kill motors if attitude error >45 deg
tasks.human_in_loop: Human operator authorizes flight volume before launch and confirms landing zone is clear.

tasks.goal: Greet arriving stewards at the Proposal Forum entrance, present the debate agenda verbally, and guide them to open seating.
tasks.terrain: Carpeted forum floor with chair rows, lectern, and power gaffer-taped runs; low steps require small humanoid stability care.
success: Greets within 5 s of person detection
safety_stops: Stop speech and motion if crowd >5 nearby
Sit-safe shutdown on battery <15%
Halt if pushed (IMU disturbance detected)
tasks.human_in_loop: Human moderator approves the day's agenda text before the robot reads it aloud.

tasks.goal: Restock printed working-group binders from the supply shelf onto the Operations Deck coordination stations during decision cycles.
tasks.terrain: Concrete deck floor with forklift-marked lanes, pallet stacks of binders, and low conveyor skids modeled on Rotterdam container-terminal layout.
safety_stops: Stop if forklift beacon active in lane
Pause if human crosses within 1 m
Abort lift if load exceeds 2 kg
tasks.human_in_loop: Human coordinator verifies station assignments before each delivery run begins.
